content.title: SILENT SIGNS OF A HIDDEN {{DEFICIENCY}}
facts: **Vitamin D** – Bone or joint pain, constant tiredness, frequent colds, and low mood that worsens in winter.
**Magnesium** – Muscle cramps, twitching eyelids, irritability, and trouble falling or staying asleep.
**Vitamin B12** – Tingling in hands or feet, weakness, memory problems, and unusually pale skin.
**Vitamin K** – Easy bruising, slow-healing cuts, and bleeding gums.
**Choline** – Brain fog, poor memory, right-sided abdominal discomfort, and low energy.
**Omega-3 (ALA)** – Dry skin, stiff joints, low mood, and trouble concentrating.
